fact: The STATAFRIC/African Union peer review report on Seychelles' national statistical system records adoption of the first National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS 2023-2027), aligned with Vision 2033 and Agenda 2063; the document gives no adoption date, so as_of is its publication date, 17 October 2025.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSPS 2023-2027.
